messages.text: Hi there. Can I get an idea of total cost of the Magic miner 40t batch 9. Sent from EU warehouse to Portugal. Thank you

The Magic Miner 40T is $799 USD, Batch 9, ships December 14, 2026.

Going to Portugal it ships from our Netherlands warehouse, so there's no import VAT, duty or customs handling fee on delivery. Nothing extra to pay when it lands.

Shipping is the only other cost, and it's worked out from your address at checkout, so pop the address in and you'll see the exact figure before you pay.

Here's the link if you want it: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t

Anything else you want to know about it?
